propositions: Duplicate allowlisted read-only tool calls (read_file, search_files, list_directory, show_ticket) must return cached results without re-executing the underlying tool function.
Tool calls returning 'Error:'-prefixed strings must not be memoized and must re-execute on subsequent identical calls without nudge text.

Deterministic sentinel-empty results like '(no matches)', '(empty)', and '(empty range)' must be memoized and trigger escalating nudge levels (L1 first repeat, L2 further repeats) to steer the model away from looping.

Memoization wrapper must nest between the runaway guard and steering logic (guard → memo → steering) such that the distinct-ratio actuator observes every duplicate signature and continues to abort pathological runs at the same call index.
Only allowlisted read-only tools are memoized; write tools like record_criterion_verdict and non-allowlisted tools must always execute.
